AI agents versus chatbots and when to use Azure
Azure AI Search, Foundry and RAG
Business value, governance and human in the loop

takeaways: Good Copilot Studio agents need structured knowledge, tools and automation, not just well-written instructions, and not every problem needs an agent.
For large or unstructured data, combining Copilot Studio with Azure AI Search for indexing, vectorization and RAG gives better and faster answers, including permission-aware results.
Measuring value with tools like the Copilot Studio Kit, keeping humans in the loop for serious decisions and managing environments and ALM are essential for scaling agents and citizen development.
hook: Many organizations expect Copilot Studio agents to solve everything with a few instructions. Microsoft MVP Nilüfer Doğan explains for Power Platform makers, architects and IT leaders how to combine Copilot Studio with Azure AI Search and RAG, measure business value and govern agents built by citizen developers.
